chapter: Hutto 1978-79: Specht, Weems and learning to play
title: Specht band's European trip and when he married
summary: Hutto asks about the wives in photos of the Specht band's trip to Europe and works out when Morehouse married, around 1921-22, relative to the 1923 trip.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I notice in the pictures of the Specht band when it went to Europe....
There were lots apparently of wives.
Were you married at the time or not?
I noticed you were...either you were married and your wife took all the pictures.
I never saw Evelyn's or any with you.
I saw some either with somebody named Dot or something. I don't know what it was. When did you marry?
'22, that would make in 1923. And you were - the band went to Europe in the summer of '23. So it would be after that.
